fusions.name: Den Roar
fusions.desc: Roars over the shield's rim in a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 14 damage to everything in it, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Weakened] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Whole Weight Behind
fusions.desc: Throws your full bulk behind the shield at a cost of 5% of your maximum health, which deals 9 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every tenth of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Full Height
fusions.desc: Rears to full height behind the shield: your maximum health rises by 20% for 12 seconds, and it restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Winter Den
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you regain 3 health a second for 8 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
